request.initial_prompt: The ruin of oligarchy is the ruin of democracy; the same disease magnified and intensified by liberty overmasters democracy—the truth being that the excessive increase of anything often causes a reaction in the opposite direction; and this is the case not only in the seasons and in vegetable and animal life, but above all in forms of government.

overmasters democracy—the truth being that the excessive increase of anything often causes
a reaction in the opposite direction. And this is the case not only in the seasons and in
vegetable and animal life, but above all in forms of government.
